def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=d["nodes"], ordered=True)
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=d["arcs"], dimen=2)

    model.open = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.Binary)

    # Decision: amount of goods transported (bounded by capacity)
    def flow_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, d["cap"][(i, j)])

    model.flow = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                         bounds=flow_bounds)

    # Objective: fixed + variable cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return (sum(d["fixed"][(i, j)] * m.open[i, j] for (i, j) in m.A)
                + sum(d["var"][(i, j)] * m.flow[i, j] for (i, j) in m.A))

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Flow conservation: incoming - outgoing = net demand
    def conservation_rule(m, n):
        incoming = sum(m.flow[i, n] for (i, j) in m.A if j == n)
        outgoing = sum(m.flow[n, j] for (i, j) in m.A if i == n)
        return incoming - outgoing == d["demand"][n]

    model.conservation = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=conservation_rule)

    # Linking: flow only if connection established, up to capacity
    def link_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.flow[i, j] <= d["cap"][(i, j)] * m.open[i, j]

    model.link = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=link_rule)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel(name="FixedChargeNetworkFlow")

    model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=d["nodes"], ordered=True)
    arcs = tuple(d["fixed"].keys())
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=arcs, dimen=2, ordered=True)

    # Precompute incoming / outgoing arc lists per node
    out_arcs = {i: [a for a in arcs if a[0] == i] for i in d["nodes"]}
    in_arcs = {i: [a for a in arcs if a[1] == i] for i in d["nodes"]}

    # ---------------- Variables ----------------
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.A, domain=pyo.Binary)

    def flow_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0.0, float(d["capacity"][(i, j)]))

    model.f = pyo.Var(model.A, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=flow_bounds)

    # ---------------- Constraints ----------------

    # (1) Linking / capacity: f_ij <= CAP_ij * y_ij
    def cap_link_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.f[(i, j)] <= d["capacity"][(i, j)] * m.y[(i, j)]

    model.cap_link = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=cap_link_rule)

    # (2) Flow conservation: incoming - outgoing = net demand
    def balance_rule(m, i):
        inflow = pyo.quicksum(m.f[a] for a in in_arcs[i])
        outflow = pyo.quicksum(m.f[a] for a in out_arcs[i])
        return inflow - outflow == d["bound"][i]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=balance_rule)

    # ---------------- Objective ----------------
    def objective_rule(m):
        fixed_cost = pyo.quicksum(d["fixed"][a] * m.y[a] for a in arcs)
        var_cost = pyo.quicksum(d["var"][a] * m.f[a] for a in arcs)
        return fixed_cost + var_cost

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=objective_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return model
